html:
TotalSegmentator (University Hospital Basel): nnU-Net v2 networks that label 117 anatomical structures (organs, bones, muscles, vessels) in CT volumes, at 1.5 mm (five networks) or 3 mm (one, faster). Commercially usable (Apache-2.0 code and weights).

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: TotalSegmentator: Robust Segmentation of 104 Anatomic Structures in CT Images, Radiology: Artificial Intelligence 2023, 2023-07-05
  • Paper: nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation, Nature Methods 2021, 2020-12-07
  • Original code: https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator at 184fa4765456
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator/blob/184fa4765456492b2ab81a981cc387465906b003/LICENSE ; https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator/blob/184fa4765456492b2ab81a981cc387465906b003/README.md
  • Training data: TotalSegmentator dataset v2 (1228 CT scans, 117 structures) (1559 CT scans of the TotalSegmentator dataset v2 (CC BY 4.0). Only the weights licence counts for the commercial flag.)
  • Kernel libraries: vol_norm
  • Variants: totalsegmentator-total, totalsegmentator-total-3mm
  • Outputs: labels
  • Input size: any D x H x W volume and its voxel spacing (resampled to the model spacing, sliding window)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): totalsegmentator-total 512x512x512 voxels (5.5 GiB peak allocated, 5.8 reserved); totalsegmentator-total-3mm 512x512x512 voxels (4.3 GiB peak allocated, 5.1 reserved)
  • totalsegmentator-total original (fp32) 200x200, original 200x200: totalsegmentator(nifti, ml=True, fast=False, device='gpu') on the in-memory NIfTI (CPU numpy in, labels out; weights load per call as upstream)
  • totalsegmentator-total-3mm original (fp32) 200x200, original 200x200: totalsegmentator(nifti, ml=True, fast=True, device='gpu') on the in-memory NIfTI (CPU numpy in, labels out; weights load per call as upstream)
  • totalsegmentator-total load / first call: original 0.07 s / 54.51 s, portable 0.77 s / 2.103 s, kernels 0.77 s / 1.879 s
  • totalsegmentator-total-3mm load / first call: original 0.06 s / 12.48 s, portable 1.18 s / 0.259 s, kernels 1.19 s / 0.209 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

A small subset of real CT cases of the TotalSegmentator dataset (not the full test split), each run at its card's spacing (1.5 or 3 mm) in the same pipeline; mean over the cases of the Dice (0 to 1) averaged over the classes present, against the ground-truth segmentations (vertebrae_L6 of the subset has no counterpart and is skipped). Original = TotalSegmentator 2.18.0, default fp16 autocast. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.003 and p99 <= 0.5 (absolute error of the output labels).
